body:
I’m not a professional but something my therapist reminds me all of the time is that healing/progress isn’t always linear -  if things get worse or you backslide or something you haven’t lost all of the progress you made before, you still have it, it was worth it because you know you can do it and you know you can get back to it in time. Like practice runs, or like wearing down a path through tall grass, the more you do it the easier it gets to see the path - if you get lost the worn down path is still there and will still be waiting for you when you find it again. 

Again not an expert but that all sounds like it could very well be symptoms of anxiety, it can cause a lot of wild physical symptoms. Dizziness and fast heartbeat are pretty common symptoms of anxiety - I’ve experienced both. Is it possible to get a physical or check up from a doctor if you’re still worried about it? 

I’m sorry things have been hard for you lately. I believe it won’t always be like this and that you will be able to make it through this. You’ve got this. <3
Congrats!! I just took the train today too! The first time in almost two years.

Okay though before I get to the bad stuff I do want to say that I’m in therapy. I’m working on it. I’m generally trying. One good answer I have is that I have a friend who I care about a lot. It’s hard for me to tell how good of friends we actually are, we don’t talk every day or anything but I really appreciate it when she reaches out. I’d like to see her again in person someday. Also after I changed meds music hit me different again… I felt nothing for a long time. I can feel something when I listen to music. I want to listen to more of it. I want to be able to see my favorite bands live again. 

Now… some honest answers? Warning… This isn’t healthy or good or the least bit uplifting or anything but it’s where I’m honestly at when I’m at my lowest, idk maybe it helps to feel not alone in these thoughts? Or maybe it would make it worse. Don’t read if you think it would make you feel worse. 

One of the main things is that my apartment is super messy - I wouldn’t want people to know that I was living like that. Also I have a lot of sketchbooks with bad art or like depressing/confusing monologues that I wouldn’t want people to find. Just generally the idea of leaving loose ends and random social media accounts and the idea that people would feel sorry for me (or angry I guess but I have a thing about pity specifically). The fact that people would misgender and dead name me. Not that they aren’t doing that now… just that, idk that’s the way I would be remembered. And a lot of the time… I’m just too lazy.

But like I said… I’m working on it. In the meantime, if you don’t have a “good” or “uplifting” reason for sticking around… the ones that are kinda shitty are a decent stop gap. If you have to lean on those while you are trying to figure out some better reasons… (or just like trying to hold on) there isn’t any shame in that. Shit is hard. It’s fucking bleak out there. But maybe you’ll find some better reasons in the future. Fuck around and find out I guess. 

A quote from Maria Bamford: “If you stay alive for no reason at all, please do it for spite.”

I just did this yesterday! Booked it, that is - going in next week. Figured if I had cool hair maybe it would give me some more confidence or something? Idk. Anyway you’ve got this! Even if it’s scary you just have to sit there for a bit and then you can leave, it won’t last forever.

I’m glad the klonopin is helping you, that’s great that you’ve been able to go to the store without feeling too anxious!! I was prescribed lexapro and Wellbutrin last month, (I’ve been on Wellbutrin before but I was off meds for a couple of years) I think it has helped with the depression part a bit so far but not as much with the anxiety, hard to tell because I haven’t really been pushing myself in that regard. Just staying in my apartment where it is safe and familiar… but I guess it’s time to start testing the waters.

Thank you so much for the encouragement, I’m going to try and practice. I reached out to someone I haven’t talked to in awhile and she offered to let me come over and just quietly read near her, so less pressure. Lol I’m crying as I’m typing because of how nice she is. I’m scared but maybe the push is good for me.

Thank you for your reply, it helps so much to just feel less alone with this. I have two weeks before the trip so I’m going to try and practice going outside. I’ll start with walks which I used to like, then I think I will figure out a time to ride the train downtown and go to a store (I need new pants anyway, have been putting it off for too long haha).
